items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Bob was telling us about your piano player... He says, 'My teacher made me go clear through the fake book.'

ctx.x: Bob was telling us about your piano player, what's his name?

He's saying, how does this kid know all these tunes? A kid your age, you know all these old people's tunes. He says, 'My teacher made me go clear through the fake book.' Now, here's a kid, I don't know, what is 23, 26, and he's working big time. Why? He knows all the tunes.
